command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys,numpy as np
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'src'))
from contract import iter_frames,point_cloud_camera
frames=list(iter_frames(root/'examples/viewer_multiframe'))
third=frames[2]; expected=point_cloud_camera(third); first=point_cloud_camera(frames[0])
results=[]
for name in ['frame_000003_1791460557654228600','frame_000003_1791460742554215400']:
    folder=root/'outputs/demo_gui'/name
    result=json.loads((folder/'processing.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    audit=json.loads((folder/'viewer_export.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    with np.load(folder/'points.npz',allow_pickle=False) as arrays: points=arrays['points_m']
    assert result['frame_id']==third.metadata['frame_id']=='ade95_synthetic_000003'
    assert audit['input_metadata']==third.metadata
    assert points.dtype==np.float32 and points.shape==(3,3)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(points,expected)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(points,[[0,0,2],[.01,0,1],[0,.03,3]],rtol=0,atol=1e-7)
    assert not np.array_equal(points,first)
    assert result['valid_depth_ratio']==.75 and audit['depth_range_m']==[1.0,3.0]
    results.append({'folder':str(folder.relative_to(root)),'frame_id':result['frame_id'],'points_m':points.tolist(),'dtype':str(points.dtype),'shape':list(points.shape),'matches_third_frame':True,'different_from_first_frame':True,'depth_range_m':audit['depth_range_m'],'file_sha256':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file()}})
print(json.dumps({'source':'agent read-only verification of user-provided saved files','status':'success','results':results},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False))
